verdict.rationale: GitHub's Issues page says users can delegate work by assigning an issue to Copilot. Projects tracks those issues, and assignee changes made in a project sync to the issue, so delegation is reachable from the Projects workflow. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, and it never shows Copilot invoked from within Projects itself. missing for 10: documentation of delegating to Copilot directly from a project view, detail on what tasks the assistant can perform and how results return to the project, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Assign an issue to Copilot when you want to delegate the work.
For example, change an assignee in your project and that change is shown in your issue.
